summary: Entra role policies are enforced again, and saving an admin reports correctly.

fixes.title: Entra role policies enforced again
fixes.text: The policy job failed on every run after the previous version. Entra role PIM policies are enforced again.

fixes.title: Saving an admin reports correctly
fixes.text: A save that worked no longer shows as failed, on the admin screen and two other save screens.

fixes.title: Smaller fixes
fixes.text: The Manager column shows the manager, the admin list no longer stalls, the department list loads, and group tags no longer warn as badly named.
